scene: EXPLICIT CONTINUATION: Trickster route, Chapter 3 or 5, Drezen, the night of the dinner after the river steps. The Commander told her to do it her way and then carried the hooded lantern for her: in the rain at the river steps she lifted her veil for the witness (Lethra the candle-seller on the dead route, Radan on the living and camp routes), stepped in as close as a friend and pushed, and watched the whole fall and the stillness at the bottom with her lips parted. At dinner the next night, in a new dress, she was charming to everyone and did not look at the Commander until the dessert, and then did not stop; the Commander held her gaze. After dinner she takes the Commander to the Commander's private quarters and the door shuts. Continue into a mutually wanted sexual encounter fed by her after-kill flush and her pleasure that the Commander watched and held the light. The killing is never summarised as a report; at most she lets one exact sensory detail of the steps (the rain, the lantern, the sound at the bottom) slip into bed-talk, pleased with herself. The new dress is part of the staging; the knife is within reach. Only Camellia and the Commander are present. End before dawn with her awake beside the Commander.
